candidates.change_summary: Change owner() to return a constant zero address instead of stored owner.
Make owner() return msg.sender instead of the stored owner.

Make owner() return the stored owner but cast through uint160 to potentially alter value (non-equivalent due to different type interpretation in assembly), by returning address(uint160(uint256(uint160($._owner)))).
Return the negation of the stored _paused flag (flip paused semantics) by changing the return expression to !paused().
